svg.title: Friedrichs diagrams for ideal MHD
svg.desc: Two polar plots of the phase speeds of the slow (solid), Alfvén (dashed) and fast (dotted) modes as a function of the angle from the magnetic field (0 degrees to the right). Left, v_A = 2 c_s: the fast mode is almost circular with radius about 2.2, the Alfvén mode is a pair of lobes reaching 2 along the field and the slow mode a pair of smaller lobes reaching 1. Right, v_A = c_s / 2: the fast mode is again almost circular, with radius about 2.2, and the Alfvén and slow modes are two nearly identical lobes reaching 1 along the field.
